entries.competence: Demonstrate the ability to apply problems solving techniques.
entries.objective: Students should be able to apply problem solving techniques in real life
entries.sub_topic: (a) Social problem solving techniques (b) Effective problems solving
entries.teaching_act: Guide students to brainstorm on the meaning of problem solving techniques, discuss and explain the importances of using problem solving techniques.
entries.learning_act: By using a role play the students in their present their findings concerning problem solving.
entries.materials: A copy of a case study on the application of problem solving techniques.
entries.assessment: (a) Explain the meaning of problem solving techniques. (b) Explain why it is important to use problem solving techniques in solving problems.

entries.competence: Demonstrate an understanding of the concept structure and functioning of governments and participate in its running.
entries.objective: Demonstrate an understanding of his/her government.
entries.teaching_act: The teacher guide students can explain the meaning and types of government and importances of government.
entries.materials: Written texts on the types and forms of governments.
entries.assessment: (a) Explain the meaning and types of government. (b) Illustrate the importances of government.

entries.competence: Demonstrate an understanding of the concept, structure and functioning of government and participate in its running.
entries.objective: Demonstrate an understanding of his/her government.
entries.teaching_act: The teacher to guide students to brainstorm on the meaning of national constitution, describe the structure of the national constitution.
entries.assessment: Explain the meaning of national constitution. (b) Structure of the national constitution.

entries.competence: Demonstrate an understanding of the concept, structure and functioning of government and participate in its running.
entries.objective: Demonstrate an understanding of his/her government.
entries.teaching_act: Guide students to:- -Define local government -Describe the structure of local government -Identify functions of local government.
entries.learning_act: Students presents their findings on the meaning of government, structure of local government and functions of local government.
entries.materials: Written texts on local and central government.
entries.assessment: Explain why local government has important effects on people’s lives? -Identify functions of local government.

entries.competence: Demonstrate an understanding of the concept, structure and functioning of government and participate in its running.
entries.objective: Demonstrate an understanding of his/her government.
entries.teaching_act: Guide students to:- -Explain sources of local government revenues. -Explain how the local government spend its revenue.
entries.assessment: Explain sources of local government revenue. (b) Explain how the local government spend its revenue?

entries.teaching_act: Guide students to:- -Explain the meaning of central government. -Describe the structure of the central government. -Explain the functions of the central government. -Differentiate between local government and central government.
entries.materials: Written text on central government expenditure.
entries.assessment: Explain the meaning of central government -Describe the structure of central government.

entries.teaching_act: Guide students to identify sources of central government revenue. -Explain the central government expenditure. -Participate in different central government activities.
entries.learning_act: Teacher to guide students to discuss how they can participate in the central government activities.

entries.teaching_act: Guide students to discuss on the -Reasons for and the importance of Tanganyika and Zanzibar union. -Union affairs in the central government.
entries.learning_act: Students discuss and present on the reasons for and the importances of Tanganyika and Zanzibar Union.
entries.materials: -Relevant information about union matters. National constitution of 1964.
entries.assessment: Differentiate union and non-union matters in the government of united Republic of Tanzania.

entries.competence: Demonstrate knowledge of democratic principles and competently participate in democratic processes.
entries.objective: Explain what democracy is and participate in democratic activities.
entries.teaching_act: Guide students to brainstorm on the:- -Meaning and types of democracy -Analyse the principles of democracy -Differentiate types of democracies
entries.learning_act: Students from their groups discuss and present their finding about -principles of a democratic country. -Differences of a democratic and non democratic country (government)
entries.assessment: Differentiate between a democratic government and non democratic.

entries.teaching_act: Assess whether Tanzania implements democracy in accordance with the principles of democracy. -Differentiate democratic from non democratic government.
entries.learning_act: The implementation of democracy in Tanzania.
entries.assessment: Explain how students participate in democratic activities?

entries.teaching_act: Guide students to brainstorm on the:- -Meaning and common features of multiparty democracy. Participation of citizens in democratic activities in the society.
entries.learning_act: Students presents their findings about the -Meaning and common features of multiparty democracy. -Participation of citizens in democratic activities in the society.
entries.materials: Written documents on common features of multiparty democracy.
entries.assessment: Explain how they can participate in democratic activities.

entries.teaching_act: Guide students in their own groups to discuss the meaning and indicators of democratic elections. -Explain the importances of democratic elections. -assess whether there are free and fair elections in Tanzania. -Demonstrate a spirit of tolerance of accepting constrictive critism and defeat.
entries.learning_act: Students presents their findings on the -Importance of democratic elections. -Free and fair elections in Tanzania. -Demonstration the spirit of tolerance by accepting constrictive critism and defeat.
entries.materials: Pictures depicting political campaigns, elections on polling day and discussions meetings.
entries.assessment: Are students able to demonstrate a spirit of tolerance by accepting constructive critism and defeat.

entries.competence: Demonstrates responsible sexual behaviour and gender relations.
entries.objective: Promote knowledge of good sexual behaviour gender concepts.
entries.teaching_act: Teacher to guide students to brainstorm on the meaning of Gender and identify different gender concepts.
entries.learning_act: Students present their findings on the meaning of gender and identify different gender concepts.
entries.materials: Pictures and charts depicting gender issues.
entries.assessment: Identify gender issues in the society.

entries.competence: Demonstrates responsible sexual behaviour and gender relations.
entries.objective: Promote knowledge of good sexual behaviour gender concepts.
entries.teaching_act: Identify gender issues in the society. -Describe socio-cultural practices that hinder equal participation between men and women in our society. -suggest the corrective measures against negative socio-cultural practices.
